reasoning: On the season so far the Magic are the stronger team; with home court the Jazz start about 1 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Jazz win 52 times in 100; most games like this end between 202 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams are in a rough patch: Orlando have lost four straight on a West trip, and the mood around first-year coach Sean Sweeney is sour. Utah have lost eight straight and play on a back-to-back. Lottery-rule quirks mean Utah have little incentive to keep losing (Memphis owns their 2027 first). Neither side has a clear mental edge, so it stays neutral.
